Before acceptance, the contract declares derivation parent_owner_outcome_id O, parent_owner_outcome_epoch 1, parent_owner_outcome_sha256 equal to the current source-bound identity, and contribution_type refine. required_outcome_coverage lists every required_outcome_id with relation directly_satisfies, contributes, verifies or not_addressed, task_criterion_ids and explanation. intentionally_not_addressed entries have parent_task_remains_open true and owner_authorization_ref null unless an explicit owner decision authorizes removal. The coverage matrix contains owner required outcome, derived criteria, relation, evidence required, weakened flag and parent-open flag. Every terminal-required outcome is represented at equal or stronger modality and target, with outcome-proving evidence; unaddressed outcomes remain owned by an open parent. A child may narrow only as a traced subtask; the root omits none, no threshold weakens, must stays must, direct results stay direct and deferral retains authority or an owning parent. No root terminal state leaves a required outcome unowned. Comparison passed before acceptance. The uncertain equivalence row was routed as a bounded comparison containing the verbatim outcome and derived contract to Extra High under the intelligence policy; deterministic mapping was insufficient.
